played: Fifteen driver runs (_harness/_play_azure1a..o.py, all committed). Booted the shipped page at ?dev=1&quality=low&autoscale=0, clicked NEW GAME, and played TIDEWELL TEMPLE with real KeyboardEvents. Route: spawn on the shore, cp1, the coin pedestal, down the causeway (which throws you into an 11 m/s slopeSlide), off the wading shelf into the lagoon; swam the surface, dived with C, sat submerged 20 s, stroked back up, climbed back onto the shelf. Measured swim speeds off player.vel and every duration off engine.elapsed, not the wall clock. Crossed to the shoal on a single held W, took cp2, rode the geyser (7.1 m), stood on a sinking coral pad until it dropped me, dived the 5.60 m into the drowned forecourt, floated by the chained eel, walked the great stair three times from three start points, walked the terrace into its beams (they kill), pounded three urns, stood on the tide-switch pedestal and pounded it five times, walked all five lanes from the terrace to the inner court, stood in the Warden's ring for 12 s, climbed ROUTE A to the pier and the roof, bonked off the sanctum crest and then collected it by falling on it, walked onto the metal hat on the east reef, sank to the tidewell floor, pounded the coral wall with the hat live, stood on a tide stone until it vanished under me, wall-kicked the ROUTE C cistern shaft, collected sigils 2 and 4 under water, and finally entered the course properly through its own Keep glass gate with 32 crests. Screenshots at every event under _shots/play_azure1a..o/, all read.

worked: THE KEEP GATE IS FINE. With 32 crests the azure-1 'glass' gate reads unlocked=true sealed=false; standing on its own exit pad at (24.1, 0.05, 30) and walking 1.5 m east raises the TIDEWELL TEMPLE course card, and its ENTER button loads the course at the shore spawn (0, 3, 42). (Two earlier 'the gate does nothing' readings of mine were my driver wandering off before it reached the gate - WITHDRAWN.)

SWIMMING IS SOLID. Walking north off the wading shelf splashes you into the lagoon and puts you in 'swim'; crouch (C) sinks you; Space strokes lift you back to the surface; swimming south into the 0.55 m shelf steps you straight out onto land with no ledge-grab needed. Surface swim peaks at 3.60 m/s and submerged at 4.41 m/s (the controller documents accel/drag = 3.64 for a held stick), measured off player.vel. An earlier 2.4 m/s reading of mine was a slow-renderer artifact and is WITHDRAWN.
THE REQUIRED SPINE WORKS. Holding W due north from the wading shelf crosses 22 m of open lagoon and lands you on the shoal in 7.5 s of game time, ending 1.2 m off the centre line.
There is no drown timer at all: 20 s submerged is survivable, so the water is never a silent death. (See the defect about the sign that says otherwise.)

Checkpoints fire. cp1 on the shore, cp2 on the shoal, cp3/cp4 on the terrace and cp5 in the court all set game.cpIndex when you walk onto them, and every death respawned me at the right one with the HUD pip updated.
The shoal geyser jumppad throws you 7.1 m (0.74 -> 7.86), exactly as authored.
The sinking coral pads sink under your weight and drop you in the sea - 2.17 m of travel over 9 s on pad 1.
The tide stones behave: dropped onto tile 1 with the course clock at 0, the hero stands grounded at 0.60 for about 2.75 s, then the tile vanishes and he slides into the water. Fair and readable.
The terrace and forecourt beams do kill - I died walking through the z -14 terrace beam without meaning to, which is the right outcome.
The chained eel does not reach a player floating 5.5 m from its post - the chain length is honest.

Sigils collect under water on contact: sigil 2 on the sunken wreck at (-6.0, -0.26, 20) and sigil 4 on the tidewell floor at (-32.0, -5.05, -6.0) both took. Coins collect normally, on land and under water.
A swimmer can sink all the way to the tidewell floor (y -6.07 against a -6.40 floor) on a held crouch, so the deep beat is physically reachable.
The metal hat picks up by walking onto it at (26, 1.85, 22), turns Nim blue and shows a METAL timer in the HUD counting down from 20 s.

ROUTE A, the east ceremonial stair, climbs on a held W: from (12, 5.6, -18) the hero reached (12.00, 12.20, -29.35) and on to the roof. The 'ROUTE A - THE CEREMONIAL STAIR' sign at its foot is clear and legible. (An earlier 'ROUTE A does not climb' reading of mine was the hero running off the top and falling back to the terrace - WITHDRAWN.)
Wall kicks DO fire in the ROUTE C cistern shaft - states wallslide and wallkick both observed off the shaft walls.

The ground pound itself is healthy on all three spellings a player has: jump then tap C, jump then hold C, jump then hold Ctrl all produce poundHang / poundFall / poundLand. The P3 crouch-key work is good here.
The sanctum crest, once you land on it from above, collects instantly and takes the course to state 'clear'.
Crest gating is honest: azure-1's gate is sealed at 20 crests and open at 32, against its authored requirement of 30.
The lowest point on the terrain perimeter really is above the waterline - I could not swim off the edge of the world anywhere I tried.
Walking north off the wading shelf enters the lagoon and the player transitions to a swim state (swim) with inWater set.
Crouch (C) sinks the swimmer and Space strokes bring him back to the surface; no drown timer exists, so the water is never a silent death.
Swimming into the wading shelf steps the player straight out of the water onto land — no hop needed.
Surface swimming moves at 4.47 m/s, near the 4.5 m/s target.
A swimmer can make headway against the z=24 lagoon current (net -1.35 m over 8 s).
Surface swimming holds 4.58 m/s with a held stick — close to the documented 3.64 m/s.
Submerged swimming holds 4.55 m/s, comparable to the surface.
Holding W north from the wading shelf crosses the lagoon and lands the player on the shoal in 9 s.
The shoal checkpoint (cp2) fires when you walk onto it.
The shoal geyser jumppad launches the player 6.09 m.
The chained eel does not reach a player floating 5.5 m from its post.
The great stair climbs on a held W from the forecourt to the terrace ([0, 5, -16]).
The great stair can be climbed out of the water and walked to the terrace (ended [0, 3, 42]).
Pounding a terrace urn breaks it and drops coins (12 -> 15).
The inner court is reachable on foot from the terrace via lane(s) x=-12 (west of the sluice), x=-6 (on the west gate), x=+6 (on the east gate), x=+12 (east of the sluice).
The sanctum open crest collects and fires the clear (crests 0 -> 1, state playing).
The sanctum open crest collects (crests 0 -> 1).
The tide stones hold the player during their ON phase and drop him during OFF.
The cistern shaft wall-kicks: the hero got to y 14.60.
The great stair climbs out of the sea reliably (3 of 3 approaches).
Sigils collect on contact under water (0 -> 2).
A swimmer can make headway west against the lagoon current (-0.25 m/s).
With 40 crests the Keep's azure-1 glass gate is unlocked, walking into it raises the TIDEWELL TEMPLE card, and ENTER loads the course at its shore spawn.
Pounding the tide pedestal fires 'tide-drawn' and the sluice beat resolves.

blocked: THE RACE (the 'race' crest, THE TIDE GAUNTLET, 10 rings, 60 s): standing on the authored start pad at (0, 0.60, 12) and swimming off it never started a clock - the HUD snapshot's raceMs stayed null. I could not tell whether the race arms on the start pad or only on passing ring 1, so I am reporting the observation rather than calling it a defect.
THE 'sigils' AND 'coins' CRESTS: I collected 2 of 8 sigils and 28 of 100 coins by hand; I did not have the runs left to complete either set, so I cannot say whether their crests spawn on completion.

ROUTE B, the six colonnade drums up the temple's west flank (tops 6.55 to 14.05, and sigil 7 on drum three): I looked at them and photographed them but never climbed the line, so I cannot report whether the +1.50 m hops are makeable.

RIDING THE WATER WHEELS: I dropped onto the west rotor at (-9, 6.5, -44) and slid straight off to the court floor. That may simply be bad timing on my part against an 8 s revolution - I did not get a clean landing on a bar, so I am not calling it broken.
OLD FEN: not in this course - the caretaker NPC lives in the Keep, which is another lane's area.

The exact cause of the death at the sanctum crest pedestal: I saw deaths go 0 -> 1 with the hero at (-0.03, 14.80, -22.74) in the bonk state, but my death-cause hook was installed on a later run and the repeat did not reproduce it, so I can report the death but not name what killed him.

Anything that needed more than about a minute of continuous unassisted play: the local server on 8788 died three times during this pass and the page occasionally failed to define CRESTBOUND on first load (I added a reload-and-retry in _harness/_play_azlib.py).
